Week 26 Module Map: Defeat of the Comanche and Opening of The Frontier

Quarter 3: The Price of Union

The frontier war finally ends, a decade after statehood rather than at it.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: Quanah Parker and the end of the Summer Moon Empire
  • Lesson 2: The Texas Frontier Opens

What to turn in

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Responsibility: notice Quanah Parker answering for his people.
